question: What alternative forms of dedicated gift are permitted in this ritual context?
premises: A gift dedicated solely to Rudra is permitted.
A gift dedicated to the Sun is also permitted.
These options are presented as alternatives.
inference: The rite may be performed either as a Rudra-gift or as a Sun-gift.
uncertainties: matha may be a variant of atha
